info.title: twa-flights-catalog
info.description: Catalog of cities extracted from the monolith. Generated from the seed data of the catalog by microcks/generate-contracts.py. The mock of GET /cities answers one code at a time; the service accepts up to 50 codes separated by comma. The errors 400 and 503 have the format of Error (code, shortDescription, reasons). x-twa-client-retry tells how the monolith retries each operation

get.summary: Get one city by its code

x-twa-client-retry.timeouts: connection and reading of catalog.remote (500 ms each by default)

503.description: The database of the catalog is not available (50301). The client retries it

get.summary: Get several cities by their codes

x-twa-client-retry.timeouts: connection and reading of catalog.remote (500 ms each by default)

parameters.name: codes
parameters.description: Up to 50 codes separated by comma, in any case. The repeated and empty ones are ignored

200.description: The cities that exist, in the order of the request and without repeated. The unknown codes are not in the list

400.description: Without codes (40001) or with more than 50 codes (40002). Not retried

503.description: The database of the catalog is not available (50301). The client retries it

timeZone.description: IANA id of the time zone, never an offset
